skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the basic concepts of tourism policy and planning, understand the importance of policy issues, and assess the impact of tourism policies on sustainable development.
Understand the concepts and characteristics of tourism planning, and analyze the potential and conditions for tourism planning.
Understand the principles and strategies of sustainable tourism management.
Identify and apply tools and techniques in tourism planning.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and evaluate resources, contexts, and indicators for policy and planning.
Demonstrate the ability to work collaboratively in group discussions and presentations.
Conduct research and analysis to forecast scenarios for tourism planning and policy development.
Develop skills in presenting research findings and policy recommendations.
Demonstrate the ability to independently update knowledge and take responsibility for learning.
